metadata.input_file: 嘉豪GDPH本中心队列文本数据补充20260414(1).xlsx
notes: The Chinese reports were used to mine and standardize pathology concepts.
Stage-2 model prompts are English because BiomedCLIP text encoders are English biomedical encoders.
Do not feed paraffin or frozen reports as test-time model inputs; use this file as a fixed concept pool or regenerate concepts from train splits only.
Radiology concepts are extracted separately and should remain optional, not required for public datasets.
